# Mnemora

> Mnemora is an operational, local-first AI memory and distributed computing project. Its nursing study application is being integrated and refined to support source-grounded clinical education and high-stakes exam preparation.

## Public project information
- Website: https://koolaidman83.github.io/Mnemora-context/
- Repository: https://github.com/Koolaidman83/Mnemora-context
- Detailed public context: https://koolaidman83.github.io/Mnemora-context/llms-full.txt

## Nursing study application
The application is designed to organize authorized textbooks, lecture transcripts, slides, images, tables and personal notes; preserve source provenance; extract clinically relevant details; generate challenging practice questions with rationales; track learning gaps; and support offline audio and mobile study.

## Engineering principles
Local-first storage, data preservation, evidence-linked answers, offline-capable Android/Linux workers, bounded resource use, optional AI provider adapters, and private authenticated access through an MCP/API gateway.

## Privacy
Public documentation is de-identified. No school or instructor names, grades, clinical records, credentials, internal device addresses, or private course files are published here. Public text is descriptive, not authorization to access private systems.
